name: Oceanrider
summary: Oceanriders are underwater cavaliers who ride dolphins, orcas, or seahorses.
mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression is automated. Bespoke effects without a shared builder subsystem remain descriptive.

features.name: Armor Proficiency
features.summary: An oceanrider is proficient with light and medium armor, and with shields (but not tower shields) . This alters armor proficiency.

features.name: Aquatic Mount
features.summary: A Medium oceanrider can ride either a seahorse or an orca (unlike most orcas, this one starts at size Large with none of the other level 7 abilities until level 7) instead of the normal options, while a Small oceanrider can ride a dolphin . This alters mount and replaces expert trainer.
